title: FlexLine Late Fee: Payments Made During the Grace Period
content:
For FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, a payment made in the grace period scales the late fee by a share.

**Rule.** The grace-payment share follows the line's latest payment (of two on the same date, the one recorded first) when it posted after the due date and no later than the last day of the grace period: a payment at least equal to the unpaid part gives 0.50; a smaller payment gives 0.90; no payment in that span gives 1.00.

The share multiplies the late fee as figured, before the fee is held to no more than the unpaid part of the minimum payment and rounded to the cent.

**Terms used.** The latest payment is the payment entry on the line with the latest date. The due date is the due date charged; the grace period is the tier's late-fee grace period, counted in calendar days from the day after that due date, so its last day is the due date plus the grace days. The unpaid part is the line's amount past due on the booking date. Where the latest payment did not post after the due date and within the grace period, the share is 1.00.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical, 10-day grace period, due date 5 May)

| Latest payment | Unpaid part | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 12 May, 40.00 | 40.00 | 0.50 |
| 15 May (last grace day), 15.00 | 40.00 | 0.90 |
| 16 May, any amount | any | 1.00 |
| 5 May (the due date itself), any amount | any | 1.00 |
| no payment ever | any | 1.00 |
